text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Kuwait, Lebanon and Egypt will cross-list shares on their bourses from Monday.
- Experts to discuss Arab petrochemical industries at a seminar in Bahrain on Monday.
- No increase in cement prices in Bahrain this year.
- The Emir, Sheikh Isa bin Sulman al-Khalifa, opens a new 26.5 million dinar causeway linking Muharraq island with the capital Manama.
- Gulf Arab labour ministers meet in Bahrain on Monday to discuss finding more jobs for citizens.
